name: Two-Story Farmhouse
description: Rubble-limestone Norman farmhouse with slate roof. Kitchen with open hearth, hall, two bedrooms. Front stair in the hall plus a rear service stair: two independent routes between floors. Shuttered casement windows on both floors. B2: half-timbered upper storey (Norman colombage) over a rubble ground floor with a string course, chamfered plinth, bevelled quoins and dressings, keystoned openings, two dormers, capped chimneys, ivy on the east gable.
